svg.text: Flick one direction, lift your finger, flick the next.
Then middle-click to accept the letter.
middle click = accept the letter (nothing drawn: accept the number or mark, else space)
left click = undo the last flick (nothing drawn: backspace) right click = space
wheel up = number 0-9 (up adds, down subtracts); middle click accepts it
wheel down from rest = punctuation: . , ? ! ' " - : ; ( ) / @ & # $ % + = * _ (middle click inserts)
no letter matches? a guess like ~W? appears: middle click takes it, left click undoes a flick
